verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments or billing platform, since a buyer comparing such products could reasonably ask for a self-hostable deployment. The evidence pack documents only Stripe-hosted services (hosted checkout pages, the hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com, Stripe-hosted invoices) and no self-hostable deployment of the core product. Client-side SDKs, CLIs and the open-source Link CLI client are developer building blocks, not a self-hosted core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
